summary: Expose Readable's Node async iterator while reusing the existing generic for-await-of lowering.

target.notes: Create the stream async iterator; consuming it drains the stream, and early return/break/throw destroys the stream by default. The surrounding for-await-of lowering remains owned by async.for-await-of / JsAsyncIterator.ForAwait.

caveats: Do not duplicate generic async-iterator close semantics in this workstream.
readable.iterator({destroyOnReturn:false}) is a distinct API and is intentionally deferred.

tests.name: for await consumes chunks
tests.expected_behavior: prints ab using the stream async iterator plus generic for-await-of semantics

tests.name: break destroys default iterator stream
tests.input: const {Readable}=require('node:stream'); (async()=>{const r=Readable.from([1,2,3]);for await(const x of r){break}console.log(r.destroyed)})();
